summary: Churchill Capital Corp XI (SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing the confidential submission of an S-4 registration statement for its business combination with Agility Robotics, Inc., as previously disclosed on June 24, 2026. The merger involves Churchill, BLB Merger Sub, Inc., and Agility Robotics. Terms such as price, premium, and valuation are not disclosed in this filing. The board recommendation is not specified. No advisors are named. This is a SPAC de-SPAC transaction, with a shareholder vote required. Watch for the S-4 effectiveness, proxy mailing, redemption dynamics, and regulatory review.
